zh-CN.title: 头像框成为真正的穿搭
items: 移除烈焰头像框，新增极光、拍立得、声浪、祈愿结与时隙五种设计
头像框加入挂件、结构变化和动态效果，并在聊天与广场等场景保持一致

en.title: Avatar frames become expressive wearables
items: Removed Blaze and introduced Aurora, Polaroid, Soundwave, Wish Knot, and Portal frames
Frames now feature ornaments, distinct silhouettes, and motion across chats and the plaza
